title: zazzle-csharp-indexer commands
description: The command lines Program.cs accepts. With no arguments it prints the usage line and exits with 2; an unknown command or argument exits with 2.

entities.name: zazzle-csharp-indexer serve
entities.description: The daemon's MCP session over standard input and output, for debugging: it lists no tools, and the internal tools answer when called by name.
entities.transport: Command line: zazzle-csharp-indexer serve [--no-daemon] [--root name=path]...; MCP on standard input and output
entities.authorization: None; runs as the user who starts it. Every root must be inside a git work tree.
entities.result: An MCP session over the roots (default: the working directory, named after its last path component) until standard input closes.
failures: An argument other than --no-daemon or --root: "bad argument", exit 2.
No daemon reachable, or one of another version still serving other clients: a note on standard error, then the in-process server.
A root that is not a directory or not inside a git work tree: the in-process server stops with that error.

entities.name: zazzle-csharp-indexer daemon
entities.description: The shared per-user daemon zazzled talks to, started by zazzled (or serve) when nothing listens.
entities.transport: Command line: zazzle-csharp-indexer daemon; clients (zazzled for the view and structure tools, and serve) connect on <state dir>/daemon.sock
entities.authorization: None checked; the socket is created readable and writable by its owner only.
entities.result: Runs until it has had no clients for the idle period, then removes the socket and exits 0.
failures: Another daemon answers on the socket: it stops with "a daemon is already running".

entities.name: zazzle-csharp-indexer init
entities.description: Wires zazzle's server (when zazzled is installed), the redirect hook and their permissions into a project's Claude Code settings, and removes an earlier registration of the indexer's own server.
entities.authorization: None; writes as the user who runs it.
entities.result: Writes .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json in the directory, prints one line per file and the snippet for AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
failures: An existing settings file that is not valid JSON: the command stops with the parse error.
No zazzled beside the indexer or on PATH: not an error; the zazzle entries are left out and the first line of output says to install zazzle and run init again.

entities.name: zazzle-csharp-indexer report
entities.description: A summary of the usage log.
entities.authorization: None; reads the invoking user's state directory.
entities.result: The report text on standard output, or "no usage recorded yet".

entities.name: zazzle-csharp-indexer hook
entities.description: Claude Code's PreToolUse hook: decides whether a Bash, Grep, Glob or Read call runs.
entities.transport: Command line: zazzle-csharp-indexer hook, with the PreToolUse event as JSON on standard input
entities.authorization: None; runs as the user Claude Code runs as.
entities.result: Exit 0 to allow; exit 2 with a message naming the zazzle tool to use on standard error to block. Blocks and raw allowances are logged.
failures: Input that is not JSON: the command stops with the parse error.

entities.name: zazzle-csharp-indexer --version
entities.description: Prints the tool version: the release's version, from its tag, or 0.0.0-dev for any other build.
entities.result: zazzle-csharp-indexer followed by ToolVersion.Text, on one line on standard output.

relatedViews.relationship: daemon carries the code-question use case, with zazzled as its client.
init, hook and report carry the command-line use cases.
The internal tools a session answers by name.
